examples.title: Table of Contents - Technical Quality Handbook Index
training_guidance: This index page lists the document structure of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-001, dated 26.10.2010)
The handbook is organized into TAB/Sheet sections covering specific manufacturing and design standards for mechanical components
The Famiglia/Family section organizes content by component types (shafts, gears, planetary systems, etc.) with reference codes (e.g., 66300-A for Piston shafts)
An NX agent should reference the appropriate TAB or Family code when implementing standards for specific component types
Subsequent pages will contain detailed dimensional, tolerance, and manufacturing rules for each listed topic
examples.summary: This is the table of contents (page 1/3) for Bonfiglioli's Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-001. It lists TAB/Sheet topics covering manufacturing details like relieving grooves, bearing seats, seal seats, threads, splines, keyways, and circlip grooves. The Famiglia/Family section indexes component families including various shaft types, gears (planetary, sun, ring), and assemblies with their corresponding reference codes.

examples.title: Document Index and Table of Contents
training_guidance: This page serves as the master index for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-001
Document references are organized into sheets (TAB series) covering manufacturing features like grooves, threads, bearing seats, and seal seats
Component family references (66xxx series) categorize parts by function: shafts (66300-66311), gears (66410-66530), and assemblies (66555-66600)
Use this index to locate specific standards for shaft features, gear components, splines, keyways, bearing interfaces, and assembly requirements
Each indexed entry points to detailed technical specifications that govern NX part modeling and validation
examples.summary: This page is the master table of contents for document MTQ-001, the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook dated 26.10.2010. It provides a structured index organized into sheets (TAB series) covering manufacturing features such as grooves, threads, bearing seats, seal seats, and keyways, and component families (66xxx series) including various shaft types, gears (planetary, sun, ring), planet carriers, and ring nuts. The index serves as a navigation tool to locate detailed technical standards for mechanical component design and manufacturing.

training_guidance: This index page maps the structure of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook, providing reference codes (TAB series and Family series) for various mechanical component standards.
When modeling shafts in NX, reference TAB 004 for seal seats, TAB 005 for bearing seats, TAB 008 for threads, and TAB 014 for keyways.
Spline modeling should consult TAB 007 for groove specifications and TAB 012 for incline spline representation.
Gear components (planetary, ring, sun) are indexed under Family codes 66301-66600.
Assembly and sectional drawing conventions are detailed in TAB 098 and TAB 099.
Use this index to navigate to specific technical sheets when validating or generating component geometry.
examples.summary: This page presents the table of contents for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook, organized into TAB (Sheet) and Family (Component) indices. The TAB section lists manufacturing and design standards for components including shafts, bearings, seals, threads, splines, keyways, and gears. The Family section categorizes component types such as piston shafts, spline shafts, planetary gears, ring gears, and various shaft configurations, providing a structured reference system for mechanical design and quality control.
